calibration.note: Photographic-only scoped calibration (approved_scope, owner Decision 14, Skill 71 update plan, 2026-10-15); source run: calibration-run-scoped-2026-10-15 on the enlarged 16-anchor designated photographic set (pools: FULL 6, ADAPT 7 binding, SUPPRESS 3). The gold_set_manifest_sha256 above hashes the producing run manifest (calibration-run-scoped-2026-10-15/gold/gold-set.json), not the assets/brand/gold-set/gold-set.json placeholder named in the schema description, which still holds 0 images and produced nothing. Approved scope carried here because the calibration record admits no approved_scope key: family-scoped: photographic only (Decision 14). Owner adjustment (Trevor Otts, 2026-10-15): the two non-color floors are set just below the lowest designated anchors so every designated anchor passes the standard it defines, where just below = the binding anchor's measured value minus 1 percent: noncolor.min_sharpness = 414.05 (GOLD-026 measured 418.23 x 0.99; computed value was 425.64) and noncolor.min_luma_std = 23.82 (GOLD-029 measured 24.06 x 0.99; computed value was 24.58); every other value stands exactly as computed. Legacy flat mirrors written alongside the nested floors: min_mean_saturation 0.4137 and min_colorfulness 60.39 mirror floors.photographic.full; min_luma_std 23.82 mirrors floors.photographic.noncolor.min_luma_std; min_sharpness 414.05 mirrors floors.photographic.noncolor.min_sharpness. The brand-wide max_protected_saturation is deliberately NOT set: the Option B ceiling lives at floors.photographic.full.max_protected_saturation (0.3660), and a brand-wide key would extend it to families this calibration does not cover; grade.families_used is likewise not set in the brand file (the scope declaration lives in the run manifest). Option B provenance (Ruling 3): the ceiling remains WARN-only, writing the value does not change its enforcement status, and the Item 12 judgment gate remains the enforcement of record for selective saturation. Owner-ruled exceptions (Trevor Otts, 2026-10-15: leave the ADAPT band as computed and record the two exceptions): GOLD-008's mean saturation 0.4592 sits above the ADAPT band ceiling 0.4176 (it is the pool maximum; the band top is p95 x 1.05 by the band's percentile design), and GOLD-031's luma_std 39.24 sits below the ADAPT tonal floor 41.13 (the floor followed the class as designated). The band stands as computed; these two designated anchors sit outside it on one check each, ruled exceptions, not errors.

page_design_rules: High-contrast color use: alternate Navy and Cream grounds; Gold is the accent and CTA color.
Each section is its own piece of art, like a fashion show: no two consecutive sections share a composition.
Image-led sections use the image at the wireframe's full slot width; no shrunken images floating in empty space.
The B masthead / CEO logo appears in the first viewport.
